input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 is a three-year, USD 6M take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right — the walk-away case — and it contradicts both our convenience-termination right in Section 9.4 and Section 12.3's disclaimer of any minimum-volume commitment. Narrowed to the fallback: current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up instead of penalty.
